meta.purpose: correct P5905 ProposalYear 2024 to 2023 (East Daley, March 2023)

verifications.note: East Daley Analytics note dated 27 March 2023. It says the Texas Railroad Commission approved WhiteWater's permit to build Blackfin on 8 March 2023, a 48 inch, 193 mile line from Colorado County to Jasper.

resolutions.researcher_notes: The sheet had a proposal year of 2024. That came from Blackfin first showing up in the Energy Information Administration (EIA) pipeline projects list in April 2024, which is a late signal and not a proposal date. An East Daley Analytics note from 27 March 2023 says the Texas Railroad Commission approved the permit to build Blackfin on 8 March 2023, so the project was public by early 2023. A Permian Basin Oil and Gas Magazine story from 21 April 2023 repeats East Daley's note and does not count as a second source. A leads site says the permit was filed in February 2023, but that site is not usable as a source, so the month is left blank. Nothing found points to 2022.
